description: Second decommissioned Indian Navy Tu-142M installed on Kakinada NTR beach in March-June 2021 and inaugurated as an aircraft museum in late Feb/1 Mar 2024; serial not found in sources consulted. Probably also covered by the museums agent. Source The Hindu 6 Mar 2021, 26 Feb and 1 Mar 2024; Hans India 7 Jun 2021.
